fixtures.rationale: 'shipped' is a status value repeated across markShipped, isShipped, and labelFor; changing that status string in one place without the others is a bug.
The header name 'x-request-id' is written by one function and read by another; a typo in either copy silently breaks the pairing.
1000 is the same tier boundary used by tierFor and discountFor; moving the boundary in one function without the other splits the tiers from their discount.
'gold' first appears in f1 and 'silver' first appears in f2; both tier names are also checked again in f3, so each name is its own repeated-literal group with its own first-occurrence function.
Both functions reference the module-level SHIPPED constant instead of repeating the 'shipped' literal themselves, so there is no repeated literal to flag.
'shipped' repeats three times, but only inside describeShipment; a literal confined to one function is not the cross-function repetition this rule targets.
'', a bare newline, 0, and 1 are all structural literals excluded by the default ignored-literal patterns, regardless of how often they repeat.
'Error' repeats as the first argument of two unrelated log calls; it is a generic word, not a value the two call sites need to keep in sync.
The filename matches the default test file pattern, so the rule produces no candidates at all regardless of its contents.
